Idaho Voter Education Videos

Have you ever wondered how elections work in Idaho? Join us in this educational video series where we go into detail on the systems and processes behind Idaho elections.
We will be covering everything from absentee ballots, voter registration, maintaining the active voter list, ballot tabulation, election certification, and much more!
A new video is added each week, so keep checking back to see what we’ll cover next!

check your voter record

This great tool will answer the following questions about your voter record:

  • Am I registered to vote?
  • What is the status of my absentee ballot?
  • What is my registered address?
  • What is my voting precinct or district?

Online Voter Registration Is Closed

Per Idaho Code 34-408, regular voter registration is currently closed until the day after the upcoming election. Any regular voter registrations received will be held by the county clerk until then. However, election day registration will be available at your precinct polling location. If you wish to register to vote on election day, you must appear in person at your precinct polling location with proof of identity and address, per Idaho Code 34-408A. Click here for Election dates.

Online Absentee Ballot Requests
Are Closed

Per Idaho Code 34-1002(7), it is past the deadline for requesting an absentee ballot for the upcoming election. The online absentee ballot request system will reopen on the day after the election, at which time voters may request an absentee ballot for any future elections this year. Click here for Election dates.
